findings.evidence: `SumRuleAssumptions.comap` needs only `σ.Bijective` (PDF/Basic.lean:218); the PR already uses `(Species.map_involutive (Equiv.swap_apply_self u d)).bijective` at PDF/Isospin.lean:208.
findings.fix: Add `def SumRuleAssumptions.speciesIsospinConj [Fintype Flavor] {f} (h : SumRuleAssumptions f) (u d : Flavor) : SumRuleAssumptions (speciesIsospinConj u d f) := h.comap (Species.map_involutive (Equiv.swap_apply_self u d)).bijective` with the `@[simp] ..._valenceTarget s = h.valenceTarget (s.map (Equiv.swap u d))` companion, and qualify the docstring paragraph to the flavour-indexed `isospinConj`.
findings.issue: No `SumRuleAssumptions.speciesIsospinConj`, although `PDF.chargeConj` carries one (`SumRuleAssumptions.chargeConj` + `chargeConj_valenceTarget`, ChargeConjugation.lean:139-147) for the same index type. The docstring's reason for omitting it on `isospinConj` (lines 33-36: "`ι` is a quark-flavour index rather than `Species Flavor`") does not apply to the species section, so a consumer holding, e.g., `PseudoscalarMeson.sumRuleAssumptionsValenceModelPdf` cannot transport it through isospin conjugation.

findings.evidence: grep for `speciesIsospinConj_self` in ./code returns no match; `isospinConj_self` is `@[simp]` at PDF/Isospin.lean:96.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem speciesIsospinConj_self (u : Flavor) (f : Pdf (Species Flavor)) : speciesIsospinConj u u f = f`, proved via `Equiv.swap_self`, `Equiv.coe_refl`, `Species.map_id`, `comap_id`.
findings.issue: The species mirror omits the analogue of `@[simp] isospinConj_self (isospinConj u u f = f)` (line 96-98), so `speciesIsospinConj u u f` never reduces under simp even though every other lemma of the flavour-indexed API (apply, comm, involutive, moments, assumptions) was mirrored.

findings.evidence: `valenceNumber := Pi.single M.valenceQuark 1 - Pi.single M.valenceAntiquark 1` (Basic.lean:178-179); `isospinConj` sets `valenceQuark := Equiv.swap u d M.valenceQuark` (Basic.lean:396); grep for `isospinConj_valenceNumber` returns no match.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem isospinConj_valenceNumber : M.isospinConj.valenceNumber = M.valenceNumber ∘ Equiv.swap u d` (true: `[a = swap vq] - [a = swap va] = [swap a = vq] - [swap a = va]` by `Equiv.swap_apply_eq_iff`).
findings.issue: `PseudoscalarMeson.isospinConj` has no interaction lemma with `valenceNumber`, the file's central derived operation, while `chargeConj` has `@[simp] chargeConj_valenceNumber` (line 225). Consumers must unfold `valenceNumber`/`Pi.single` to compute the valence numbers of an isospin-conjugate meson.

findings.evidence: `PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` (PDF/Isospin.lean:214) gives `valenceNumber (speciesIsospinConj u d f) i = valenceNumber f (swap u d i)`; grep for `hasValenceNumbers_isospinConj` returns no match.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem hasValenceNumbers_isospinConj_iff (M) (f) : M.isospinConj.HasValenceNumbers (PDF.speciesIsospinConj u d f) ↔ M.HasValenceNumbers f`, from `valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` and the meson-level `isospinConj_valenceNumber` requested above.
findings.issue: No transport of the valence assignment through isospin conjugation, although `@[simp] hasValenceNumbers_chargeConj_iff` exists for the parallel operation (Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:160-165) and `PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` is added by this PR. §1.4 (K⁺/π⁺ via `Equiv.swap d s`) needs exactly this form.

findings.evidence: `IsChargeConjCovariant.apply_chargeConj` at Meson/Pdf/Isospin.lean:144-147; grep for `apply_isospinConj` returns no match.
findings.fix: Add `theorem IsIsospinCovariant.apply_isospinConj (hI : IsIsospinCovariant b F) (hb : b.IsIsospinLimit) (M) (s) (x Q2 : ℝ) : F M.isospinConj s x Q2 = F M (s.map (Equiv.swap u d)) x Q2`, mirroring `apply_chargeConj`.
findings.issue: `IsIsospinCovariant` has no pointwise elimination lemma, while `IsChargeConjCovariant` gets `apply_chargeConj` (line 144). Since the predicate is a `def` (body unexposed), downstream users must go through `isIsospinCovariant_iff` and then `speciesIsospinConj_apply` for the species-level statement of any meson other than the pions.

summary: The new species-level isospin conjugation mirrors the charge-conjugation API only partially: the sum-rule bundle transport, the degenerate-swap simp lemma, the meson valence-number relabelling and the valence-assignment transport are all missing, and `IsIsospinCovariant` has no pointwise elimination lemma although `IsChargeConjCovariant` does.
